$comment: Transcribed from the working React clone's own render tree (src/App.jsx and src/components/*.jsx), cross-checked against the Playwright-measured CLONE_SPEC.md. Where the two disagree, the code wins (see README.md).

meta.source: Datashake marketing site (single-page), as rebuilt in this project's src/
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; hand-edit ia.json only, IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs

categories.SHELL: Site-wide chrome: top navigation and footer.
categories.PROOF: Third-party social proof: customer logos and named testimonials.
categories.VALUE: Problem/solution narrative framing why the product exists.
categories.FEATURES: Product capability and use-case explanation modules.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose primary job is a sign-up, trial or booking action.
categories.LAYOUT: Purely structural, content-free separators between sections.

shell.navbar.description: Top navigation: Datashake logo, four hover dropdowns (Product, Solutions, Resources, Company; Solutions carries the eight industry icons), Login and Book a call buttons; collapses to a hamburger with a scroll-locked slide-down menu at 991px and below.

hero.home.description: Two-column hero: coverage-report eyebrow pill, H1 ending in a vertically rotating data-source word (GSAP timeline), Book a demo and Explore the platform buttons on the left; scroll-scrubbed hero Lottie illustration on the right.
hero.home.scope: Present on the only route, /, directly after the navbar.

proof.logo-strip.description: Six-cell customer-logo row (Qualtrics, Yext, The Home Depot, Brightlocal, Epicor, Talkwalker) under a one-line caption; each cell links to an industry page and on hover swaps grey logo for colour, fills the cell and slides in an arrow.
proof.logo-strip.scope: Present on the only route, /, directly after the hero.

layout.lines-divider.description: Content-free horizontal band of decorative line artwork (Line-Divider / Divider-Horizontal SVGs) that separates two content sections inside the bordered page container.
layout.lines-divider.scope: Used only on /, where it repeats 10 times between content sections; never adjacent to itself and never after the footer.

value.problem.description: Problem statement block ('You're making decisions on incomplete data foundations') with a scroll-scrubbed problem Lottie, framed by vertical side-strip columns.

value.solution.description: Solution statement block ('Get the most complete data to power your insights') with a scroll-scrubbed solution Lottie and a See Datashake in action button, framed by side-strip columns; it directly follows the problem block with no divider between them.
value.solution.scope: Present on the only route, /, immediately after value.problem.

features.build-ideas.description: Centred 'What would you build...' heading with a Typed.js line cycling through example products, over an interactive p5 bar-canvas background (bars grow near the pointer).

features.reliable-infrastructure.description: Infrastructure pitch ('Your most reliable source of social & review data at scale') with supporting copy, a Book a demo button and the one-shot 970-04 Lottie.

features.benefits-tabs.description: Sticky four-tab benefits module (Speed, Depth, Coverage, Relevance): each pane has its own title, copy and looping Lottie; tabs auto-advance every 8s with a progress bar, and the tab strip scrolls horizontally on mobile.

conversion.free-trial.description: Dark-green free benchmark trial card: green 'Free Benchmark Trial' eyebrow, a small centred white heading, a four-point dashed checklist and a CTA over a green squares background pattern.

features.use-case-grid.description: 'What global companies use Datashake for' grid of 9 illustrated use-case cards (crisis monitoring, trend detection, competitive analysis, regulatory compliance and others) under a 'Power Your Data' eyebrow and a Book a demo button. Not an industry icon grid.

proof.testimonials.description: Four named customer testimonials, each with its own pastel colour and background SVG: on desktop (992px and up) vertical tab strips expand the chosen quote with a 0.8s width transition; below that, all four quotes stack.

support.faq.description: 'Your questions, answered' accordion of 14 question/answer pairs with dashed hairline rows and a plus icon that rotates to 45 degrees when open.

conversion.book-call.description: Closing centred CTA band ('Book a call with one of our data experts') with a single primary button over the CTA-Background image.
conversion.book-call.scope: Present on the only route, /, as the last content block before the footer (separated by one divider).

shell.footer.description: Footer: newsletter area (HubSpot form in the original, a reserved-height placeholder in the clone), four link columns (Solutions, Product, Company, Legal), copyright line, a p5 bar-canvas background and its own built-in trailing lines divider.
shell.footer.scope: Present on the only route, /, as the final block.
